n_adoption_cohorts_note: Baseline Law: 1997 (TX, LA), 2001 (AL), 2002 (DE), switching off from 2004; Table 12 adds SD 2003, VA 2004, NV 2005 (6 cohorts, absorbing).
eligible_reason: Design qualifies but no data or code are shipped. Equation (1) regresses Lease on Law (state antirecharacterization laws by state of incorporation: TX/LA 1997, AL 2001, DE 2002, switched off from 2004) with firm and year FE; column (1) of most tables has no controls (Table 2 col 1: -0.64, SE 0.29, N 68,403), clustered by incorporation state. Columns (2)-(4) add lagged firm controls and rating dummies. Table 5 (other outcomes) and Table 14 (alternative lease measures) include controls in every column; Table 9 Panel B adds a Neighbor-law treatment. The package contains only the LaTeX source of the paper (final.tex, bib, figures).
design_notes: Firm-year Compustat panel 1994-2010 (Table 2 col 1 N = 68,403). Staggered by state of incorporation, never-treated firms in other states, treatment ends in 2004 (federal preemption); Table 12 ignores preemption and adds SD/VA/NV. Table 8 col 1 is a binned event study (Law-1, Law0, Law+1, Law+2) with firm and year FE and no controls. Appendix event studies (Law-6 ...) and subgroup tables not counted.
data_files_note: Archive holds 'Collateral and Lease/' with final.tex, main.bib, .bst/.cls style files and three .eps figures only; no code, no data. Compustat is licensed.
screener_notes: Published PDF text read (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2019.3338.txt; papers/mnsc/mnsc.2019.3338.pdf). 17 qualifying main-text columns recorded (column (1) or (5) without controls in Tables 2-4, 6-13). Eligible only if the author supplies data; Compustat-based reconstruction would need incorporation-state history.
